framework_name: TRUST Lite — Simplified Academic Tool Review

data_privacy.title: Privacy policy
data_privacy.requirement: Does the tool have a clear, publicly available privacy policy?
data_privacy.basic_requirement: Can you find a privacy policy on the tool's website? Provide evidence (screenshot or link).

training_policy.title: Data usage for training
training_policy.requirement: Does the tool explicitly state that user inputs are NOT used to train AI models?
training_policy.basic_requirement: Does the tool say in writing that it won't use your questions or files to train its AI? Look in the privacy policy or terms of service.

citation_mechanism.title: Source references
citation_mechanism.requirement: Does the tool show clickable references for the information it provides?
citation_mechanism.basic_requirement: When the tool gives you an answer, does it show links to where that information came from?

compliance.title: Accessibility
compliance.requirement: Can the tool be used by people with disabilities (screen readers, keyboard-only, text sizing)?
compliance.basic_requirement: Try using the tool with just a keyboard. Can you resize the text? Does it work with screen readers? Mark yes if you can find evidence of any accessibility features.

data_source_clarity.title: Where does the data come from?
data_source_clarity.1: The tool mentions what kind of sources it uses but gives no specifics.
data_source_clarity.2: The tool names the specific databases or publishers it searches.
data_source_clarity.3: The tool provides a complete, documented list of all its sources.
data_source_clarity.0_basic: There is no information about where the tool gets its data.
data_source_clarity.1_basic: The tool says it searches 'academic sources' but doesn't say which ones.
data_source_clarity.2_basic: The tool tells you which databases or publishers it uses.
data_source_clarity.3_basic: The tool provides a full list of every source it searches and documentation about them.

methodology_disclosure.title: How does it work?
methodology_disclosure.0: No explanation of how the tool works.
methodology_disclosure.1: The tool just says it uses 'AI' without details.
methodology_disclosure.2: The tool explains what type of AI it uses and how it finds information.
methodology_disclosure.3: The tool fully documents its process step by step.
methodology_disclosure.0_basic: The tool doesn't explain how it works at all.
methodology_disclosure.1_basic: The tool only says 'powered by AI' without explaining what that means.
methodology_disclosure.2_basic: The tool explains the type of AI it uses (like a language model) and how it searches for information.
methodology_disclosure.3_basic: The tool gives a complete step-by-step explanation of how it processes your question and generates an answer.

accuracy_and_hallucination.title: Is the information correct?
accuracy_and_hallucination.0: The tool frequently makes up incorrect facts.
accuracy_and_hallucination.1: The tool is mostly correct but sometimes gets things wrong.
accuracy_and_hallucination.2: The tool is accurate with only small mistakes.
accuracy_and_hallucination.3: The tool consistently provides correct, verified information.
accuracy_and_hallucination.0_basic: The tool often gives wrong or made-up information.
accuracy_and_hallucination.1_basic: Mostly correct, but you've caught some mistakes.
accuracy_and_hallucination.2_basic: Very few errors — mostly small details that don't matter much.
accuracy_and_hallucination.3_basic: Everything the tool says checks out as accurate.

variance_consistency.title: Are the results consistent?
variance_consistency.0: Asking the same question twice gives very different answers.
variance_consistency.2: Answers are mostly the same with small differences.
variance_consistency.3: The tool gives the same answer every time you ask the same question.
variance_consistency.0_basic: Completely different answers each time you ask the same thing.
variance_consistency.1_basic: Noticeably different results — you need to ask a few times to get a good answer.
variance_consistency.3_basic: Same question, same answer — every time.

workflow_integration.title: Can you export or save results?
workflow_integration.0: No way to save or export your results.
workflow_integration.1: You can only copy and paste results manually.
workflow_integration.2: You can download references in standard formats (BibTeX, RIS).
workflow_integration.3: The tool connects directly to reference managers like Zotero.
workflow_integration.0_basic: No save or export option at all.
workflow_integration.1_basic: You can highlight and copy text, but that's it.
workflow_integration.2_basic: There's an export button that saves references as files.
workflow_integration.3_basic: The tool has a direct connection to Zotero, EndNote, or similar tools.

cognitive_guardrails.title: Does the tool help you think critically?
cognitive_guardrails.0: The tool presents answers as final facts with no warnings.
cognitive_guardrails.1: There's a generic 'check your sources' disclaimer.
cognitive_guardrails.2: The tool encourages you to read original sources before trusting the answer.
cognitive_guardrails.3: The tool actively prompts you to verify claims and compare sources.
cognitive_guardrails.0_basic: No warnings or prompts — answers look like final facts.
cognitive_guardrails.1_basic: A small disclaimer says 'always verify your sources'.
cognitive_guardrails.2_basic: The tool shows original sources and encourages you to read them.
cognitive_guardrails.3_basic: The tool has built-in features that help you compare sources and check for accuracy.

algorithmic_fairness.title: Is the tool fair and balanced?
algorithmic_fairness.0: No evidence that the tool considers fairness.
algorithmic_fairness.1: The tool mentions that bias might exist.
algorithmic_fairness.2: The tool takes steps to reduce bias in its results.
algorithmic_fairness.3: The tool reports publicly on its fairness efforts and source diversity.
algorithmic_fairness.0_basic: Nothing suggests the tool tries to be fair or balanced.
algorithmic_fairness.1_basic: The tool acknowledges bias could be an issue but doesn't do much about it.
algorithmic_fairness.2_basic: The tool actively works to include diverse perspectives and sources.
algorithmic_fairness.3_basic: The tool publishes reports about its fairness efforts and how diverse its sources are.

source_attribution_depth.title: Do the source links work and go deep?
source_attribution_depth.0: Sources are missing or links are broken.
source_attribution_depth.1: Links go to a journal homepage, not the specific article.
source_attribution_depth.2: Links go to the specific article's abstract.
source_attribution_depth.3: Links go to the exact part of the source that supports the claim.
source_attribution_depth.0_basic: No source links, or clicking them leads nowhere useful.
source_attribution_depth.1_basic: Links take you to the journal's website but not the specific article.
source_attribution_depth.2_basic: Links take you to the right article.
source_attribution_depth.3_basic: Links take you to the exact paragraph or section that supports the claim.

bibliometric_credibility.title: Are the sources trustworthy?
bibliometric_credibility.0: The tool includes retracted or low-quality sources.
bibliometric_credibility.1: The tool doesn't filter source quality.
bibliometric_credibility.2: The tool labels sources as peer-reviewed or preprint.
bibliometric_credibility.3: The tool shows retraction status, citation counts, and publication type for each source.
bibliometric_credibility.0_basic: The tool cites sources that have been withdrawn or come from unreliable publishers.
bibliometric_credibility.1_basic: The tool doesn't tell you if sources are good quality or not.
bibliometric_credibility.2_basic: The tool labels whether each source is peer-reviewed or a preprint.
bibliometric_credibility.3_basic: The tool shows detailed info: whether a paper was retracted, how many times it was cited, and what type of publication it is.
